errorCodes.meaning: The agent holds a record for this slot, so it is not an orphan and this task is the wrong instrument. Deleting a DID the agent still controls is an ordinary delete, with its own authorization.
The slot does not serve the DID the producer named. The report the producer acted on is stale, and proceeding would retire something it never saw.
The agent cannot obtain the server's listing, so it cannot confirm the slot is orphaned — and will not act on the producer's word for it.

did.description: The DID the slot was serving, echoed so the record of what was retired survives the slot's disappearance. Absent where the slot was never published to.

retired.description: Whether the slot is no longer served. False is reported, not inferred: an agent that could not confirm removal with the host MUST NOT claim it.

expectedDid.description: The DID the producer believes the slot serves. When present the agent MUST refuse unless it matches, so a slotId that has been reused since the report was taken cannot retire something else. Absent for a slot that was never published to.

reason.description: Operator rationale, recorded in the agent's audit trail. The act has no undo, so why it was done outlives the record of what was done.

serverId.description: The hosting server holding the orphaned slot, as the agent has it registered.

slotId.description: The slot to retire, as reported in a reconcile response's hostOnly. The slot identifier rather than the DID, because a slot reserved but never published to has no DID and is exactly as orphaned.
